decisions.reason: As a core airside efficiency product with its own page, its option value remains high and keeping costs are low.
The connectivity module supports integration across apron systems, and with uncertainty still unresolved its option value justifies low-cost retention.
Revenue billing is less central to integrated operations, but as an early-stage option with low marginal cost and unresolved prospects we keep it.
Equipment monitoring fits the lifecycle services model and remains a valuable option while its market acceptance is still uncertain.
Resource management complements existing planning modules and is inexpensive to keep as uncertainty resolves.
Controller safety alerts align with safety-critical tower operations, and the option is retained pending clearer demand signals.
